verdict.rationale: mParticle's own docs show configurable pipelines that keep running once set up: audiences connected to an output for activation (x2), conditional forwarding rules such as "Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present" (x3), and data forwarding to downstream services (25). These amount to rule-based background data flows, not a general automation or agentic feature. The AI capability shown (22) only suggests audience logic from a described goal and does not act autonomously. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose automation or workflow builder with triggers and schedules, agentic AI that acts on its own in the background, explicit documentation that these flows run continuously or on a schedule without user intervention, and independent corroboration.
